issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Type Operators - ToDate/ToDateTime/ToTime conversion functions
issues.evidence: `python3 .temp/qa/cql06_skeptic_probe.py` found that `fhir4ds/cql/duckdb/macros/conversion.py::_create_private_function` catches all `Exception` values and silently returns. A synthetic RuntimeError from private `ToDate`/`ToDateTime`/`ToTime` helper registration was swallowed, which can leave public conversion macros pointing at missing helpers instead of failing registration visibly.
issues.root_cause: `_create_private_function` used a blanket `except Exception: pass`, treating unexpected helper registration failures the same as duplicate registration conflicts.
issues.resolution: Changed private conversion helper registration to catch only DuckDB duplicate/catalog-style registration exceptions and log them; unexpected failures now raise. Added focused regression coverage.
